advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Replace the source-text grep in test_store_modules_never_bare_fetch_the_tickets_branch with a behavioral guard (or rely on the existing narrow-refspec converge tests), since the current allowlist is coupled to the internal 'refspec' variable name and breaks on a behavior-preserving refactor.
evidence: tests/unit/test_push_narrow_refspec.py:216-219: `if stripped.startswith("#") or '"fetch"' not in stripped: continue` then `if "refs/remotes/" in stripped or "refspec" in stripped: continue`

src/rebar/_store/sync.py:234-235: `refspec = f"+refs/heads/{branch}:refs/remotes/{remote_name}/{branch}"` / `if not _ok(tracker, "fetch", remote_name, refspec, "--quiet"):` — the fetch line contains neither the refs/remotes/ literal nor the destination refspec text; it survives the guard only because the local variable is spelled 'refspec'. Renaming it to `spec` would make this a false offender with no behavior change.

Refactoring-violation: the genuine push.py behavior (converge under a narrow refspec) is already covered by test_push_retry_converges_when_remote_tracking_ref_is_absent/_is_stale driving the real push_tickets_branch and asserting the observable converged postcondition, so this grep adds text-coupling risk without adding behavioral coverage.
advisory.finding: test_store_modules_never_bare_fetch_the_tickets_branch asserts on the TEXT of the source under test (_store/*.py), not on behavior: it greps each line for the literal token "fetch" and treats a line as safe only if it also contains 'refs/remotes/' or the literal substring 'refspec'. sync.py:235 passes solely because its local variable is named 'refspec' — so the guard is coupled to an internal variable name and would flag a false offender on a behavior-preserving rename or a helper extraction, making it a source-grepping change-detector rather than a behavior verifier.
advisory.suggested_fix: Drop the source-grep guard in favor of a behavioral reintroduction guard for the other _store fetch site (e.g. a narrow-refspec reconverge test for sync.py mirroring the push tests), or at minimum assert on the fetched ref's observable advance rather than the presence of a literal token/variable name in the source line.

coaching.coaching: Delete the change-detector / tautological test the text-grep source guard over _store; do not re-pin it to the new source text — a test that only mirrors the implementation asserts nothing.
coaching.subject: the text-grep source guard over _store
